name: LM Studio Provider
description: This enables the use of LM Studio for the AI module.
project_description: Registers a local LM Studio server as an AI provider for the Drupal AI module. LM Studio runs LLMs on a local machine behind an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API; this module points the AI module at that server (host name + optional port) so chat and embeddings operations run against locally-hosted models — useful for developers and data scientists who want to test and tweak models in a controlled environment before deploying at scale. Model discovery reads the server's /v1/models endpoint. No API key is used (a legacy api_key config value was removed by an update hook). An install hook migrates configuration from the older AI-core submodule (provider_lmstudio).
